note: Alberta Parks campground in Ghost Airstrip Provincial Recreation Area, about 56 km northwest of Cochrane on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 40), operated by Red Rock Sawmills: long loops in pine forest beside the Ghost River. Popular with off-roaders, but OHVs must be trailered from the campground to the designated staging areas. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks camping page and the operator's (Red Rock Sawmills) page: 169 unserviced sites at C$40 (firewood included), pull-throughs, vault toilets, non-potable pump, season May 1-Oct 14, mixed reservable/FCFS. Booking corrected to phone/email with the operator (reservations open March 1; the shop holds only the group camps); C$12 fee confirmed. Pin ~630 m east of the loops (move proposed). OHV wording flagged.
flags: OHV (reviewer's call; I read it as a general campground with an OHV side, not a trailhead camp): Alberta Parks page: 'There are hiking and OHV trails in the surrounding areas. Please keep OHVs on trailers until you reach the off-site trailhead.' Operator page: 'this campground is a popular base camp for off-roaders', 'Off-Highway Vehicle (OHV) Access: One of the area's key attractions—bring your ATV or dirt bike and explore the extensive OHV trail network nearby. Trail staging is allowed in designated areas only. You have to trailer out from this campground.' No trail access from the sites.
